text: Across the three d_model=128 seeds (22: 0.108, 23: 0.045, 24: about 0.058), is the per-seed N=64 minus N=128 force gap at d128 a fixed fraction of the same seed's d64 gap? Seed 24's d64 gap is still unmeasured, so a seed-24 d64 N=64/N=128 pair would test whether width removes a constant share of the deficit.
